notes: Read SKILL.md and references/details.md in full. The skill explains observability for Istio/Linkerd meshes (golden signals, sampling guidance) and provides templates: Prometheus scrape config and ServiceMonitor, PromQL queries, Jaeger and Kiali manifests, an OpenTelemetry Collector config, a Grafana dashboard JSON and PrometheusRule alerts.

Medium: the one shell block (references/details.md:118-137) installs the Linkerd viz extension into the user's cluster via `linkerd viz install | kubectl apply -f -` and runs read-only linkerd viz inspection commands (top, routes, tap, edges). Acceptable because it installs a standard extension in the user's own mesh; everything else is configuration the user applies themselves.

Users should know: the Kiali template uses `auth.strategy: anonymous` with access to all namespaces and the OTel Jaeger exporter sets `tls.insecure: true`; these are dev-oriented defaults to tighten before production. Tracing sampling is 100% in the Jaeger example, with the skill advising 1-10% in production.
